one_liner: Xero has a broad REST accounting API with self-serve OAuth 2.0 app registration and a free Starter tier (5 connections); official hosted Remote MCP exists (Starter limited to demo org).
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow (PKCE supported) for multi-user apps; Custom Connections is a client-credentials option for single-org. No API keys.
access_notes: Free developer account and free Starter tier (5 connections, 1,000 calls/day/org). Higher tiers cost money. Journals endpoint, XPM and bulk connections need Advanced plan plus security assessment and approval. Remote MCP on Starter works with demo org only; Core and above includes full use.
blocker_notes: Starter caps at 5 connections and 1,000 calls/day/org; journals endpoint needs Advanced tier with approval. Not blocking building and testing core toolkit.

evidence.quote: The Xero API does not support basic API Key authentication. Our API uses OAuth 2.0 which means you need to register your app to get a client id and client secret
